applicant.name: Dr. Felix Brandner
applicant.organisation: Medical University research group for digital cardiology

purpose: We develop and validate a machine-learning model that predicts unplanned readmission after a heart failure hospital stay. The model needs each patient's individual sequence of stays and diagnoses; aggregated statistics cannot capture these trajectories.
question: Provide pseudonymised encounters, conditions and medications for adults with heart failure who had at least one inpatient stay. Only model weights and validation metrics will leave the environment.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Cohort = adults with heart failure who had at least one inpatient stay.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
